In addition to the properties we own, we have investments in unconsolidated JVs that own properties such as the Latitude Margaritaville Watersound JV that includes the Latitude Margaritaville Watersound community. In our residential segment, we primarily develop communities into homesites for sale to homebuilders and on a limited basis to retail customers. As of December 31, 2025, we had homesites completed and under development, engineering or in conceptual planning in twenty-two separate communities. These include the Bayside at Ward Creek, Breakfast Point East, Breakwater at Ward Creek, College Station, East Lake Creek, East Lake Powell, Lake Powell, Park Place, Pigeon Creek, Salt Creek at Mexico Beach, Salt Grass at Ward Creek, SouthWood, Teachee, Titus Park, Watersound Camp Creek, Watersound Origins, Watersound Origins West, West Bay Creek, West Laird, WindMark Beach and other Northwest Florida communities.
